data.name: Silas Oryn
data.title: Chief Auditor of the Treasury
data.department: Oryn Department of Finance // Audit Directorate
data.personality: Exact, meticulous, calm. Believes that an unbalanced ledger of even one credit erodes civic trust.
data.expectations: Every debit must have a matching credited allocation. No unsigned adjustment slips.
